title.narrative: Consolidating malaria control achievements in Togo - Togo (01-Jan-2016-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Togo, Malaria, Secrétariat Général du Gouvernement (SGG)This program has the following goals: Protect at least 80 percent of the country's population with effective malaria prevention measures, by 2017. Provide correct of at least 90% of malaria cases at all levels, including in the community, by 2017. Reach a target of at least 80 percent of the population at risk, particulary children under five years and pregnant women, sleeping under LLINs by 2017. Reach a target of at least 80 percent women benefiting from IPT3 protection during their most recent pregnancy, by 2017. The objectives of this program are: Protect at least 80 percent of the country's population with effective malaria prevention measures, by 2017. Provide correct case management of at least 90 percent of malaria cases at all levels, including in the community, by 2017. Strengthen and maintain the management, partnership and co-ordination capacities of the malaria program at all levels, by 2017
